newsitem.title: UK: BP sees room for more refinery margin improvement.
newsitem.headline: BP sees room for more refinery margin improvement.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc (BP) said on Tuesday it saw some scope for better refining margins thanks to falling crude oil prices.
"The recent weakening of the crude oil price may lead to some further improvement in downstream margins," BP said in a statement.

BP said first quarter refining and marketing operating profits rose to 179 million sterling from 156 million last year largely due to higher volumes in marketing and sustained improvement in refinery performance.
"The impact of these improved marketing margins was offset by weaker refining margins, particularly in Europe," BP said.
Worldwide average margins fell to $2.00 a barrel from $2.20 a year ago, with 30-40 cent falls in the United States and Europe cancelling out a 20-cent rise in Singapore, the company said.
